title: White Rabbit Vigenere
banner: A repeating-key Vigenere message was intercepted. The key is CAT.

/home/analyst/notes/cipher.txt.content:
cipher: vigenere
key: CAT
ciphertext:
  hoenop vhx yhbve kcbukt

Spaces are preserved for readability but are not part of the encryption.

/home/analyst/decrypt.py.content:
cipher = "hoenop vhx yhbve kcbukt"
key = "CAT"

plain = []
index = 0
for ch in cipher:
    if ch == " ":
        plain.append(ch)
        continue
    shift = ord(key[index % len(key)]) - ord("A")
    plain.append(chr((ord(ch) - ord("a") - shift + 26) % 26 + ord("a")))
    index += 1

print("".join(plain))
